title: Mind Your Boundaries: Boundary-Aware Model Obfuscation against Cross-node Attack
abstract: arXiv:2610.27135v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: With the advancement of powerful AI chips, on-device machine learning is gaining traction for its low latency and privacy protection. However, when edge devices are compromised, attackers can obtain white-box access to the deployed models by reversing the apps directly to obtain the knowledge of peer devices, which is known as Cross-Node Attacks, like performing efficient adversarial attacks. Most existing defenses target known vulnerabilities, yet white-box access still enables attackers to uncover more unknown weaknesses. This creates a critical risk for edge-device deployments, where one compromised device can endanger all models distributed from the same source. translated_title: 注意你的边界：面向跨节点攻击的边界感知模型混淆
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.27135v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：随着强大AI芯片的发展，端侧机器学习凭借其低延迟和隐私保护优势正日益受到关注。然而，当边缘设备被攻破时，攻击者可以通过逆向应用程序直接获得对已部署模型的白盒访问，进而获取对等设备的知识，这被称为跨节点攻击，例如执行高效的对抗攻击。大多数现有防御针对的是已知漏洞，然而白盒访问仍然使攻击者能够挖掘出更多未知的弱点。这给边缘设备部署带来了严重风险：一台被攻破的设备可能会危及所有从同一来源分发的模型。基于模型鲁棒性主要受决策边界曲率影响的发现，我们研究了模型参数如何塑造其曲率。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的方法BMO，通过混淆模型参数来多样化决策边界……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出BMO方法，通过边界感知的模型参数混淆来多样化决策边界，从而防御跨节点攻击，避免一台被攻破的边缘设备危及所有同源分发的模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes BMO, a boundary-aware model obfuscation method that diversifies decision boundaries by obfuscating model parameters, defending against cross-node attacks so that one compromised edge device cannot endanger models distributed from the same source.
